headline: Bitcoin follows market sell-off and falls below 60,000 dollars
summary: The largest cryptocurrency fell below the $60,000 level on Friday morning for the first time since July, extending a broader market sell-off.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and is widely used as a barometer of risk appetite in digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The price fell below $60,000 for the first time since July, per the report.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
